cards.name: Sample Searcher
cards.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: add 1 Sample card from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Sample Extender
cards.text: If you control a Sample monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.

cards.name: Sample Interruption
cards.text: Quick Effect: negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

cards.name: Sample Recovery
cards.text: Target 1 Sample card in your GY; add it to your hand.

cards.name: Sample Breaker
cards.text: You can banish 1 card your opponent controls.
